You ought to see my Cindy
She lives away down south
She's so sweet the honey bees
Surround her mouth

Get along home, Cindy, Cindy

Get along home, Cindy, Cindy
I'll marry you someday

title: Old Dan Tucker
lyrics:
Old Dan Tucker was a fine old man
Washed his face in a frying pan
Combed his hair with a wagon wheel
Died with a toothache in his heel

Get out the way, old Dan Tucker
You're too late to get your supper
Supper's over and breakfast's cookin'
Old Dan Tucker just stands there looking

title: Low Bridge (The Erie Canal Song)
lyrics:
I've got a mule, her name is Sal
Fifteen years on the Erie Canal
She's a good old worker and a good old pal
Fifteen years on the Erie Canal

Low bridge, everybody down
Low bridge, for we're coming to a town
And you'll always know your neighbor
You'll always know your pal
